tables.title: NEP Origins and Early Milestones
matrix: Created the policy opening for long-term restructuring
Linked national unity to redistribution and growth
Second Malaysia Plan and early implementation
Translated NEP goals into concrete programs
Third Malaysia Plan and revised targets
Closed the original policy cycle before the NDP
notes: Use this table for a compact chronology rather than a deep event history.
The anchor dates are the 1969 crisis, the 1971 launch, and the 1990 endpoint.
Keep the wording neutral and benchmark-friendly.

tables.title: NEP Goals and Policy Instruments
matrix: Education, land programs, rural support, public services
Reduce racial concentration in occupations and ownership
Affirmative action, recruitment rules, ownership measures
Broader participation in the modern economy
Reduce the political salience of economic inequality
Public investment, industrial policy, state coordination
Support legitimacy for the policy order
notes: The matrix separates goals from instruments so extraction stays clean.
It should be read as a policy design table, not as a list of every program.
The logic row is the key interpretive element.

tables.title: Redistribution Channels Under the NEP
matrix: Built future participation rather than immediate cash transfer
Corporate equity and commercial access measures
Addressed the distribution of capital, not only income
Linked poverty reduction to spatial development
Helped create a broader entrepreneurial base
notes: The channels are intentionally generic enough to survive later canonical refinement.
Avoid unsupported share targets or program totals in this research stage.
The table is meant to support extraction of the policy mechanism.

tables.title: NEP Growth Strategy and Sectoral Direction
matrix: Build roads, utilities, ports, and urban systems
Lower transaction costs and raise connectivity
Use the state to guide strategic sectors
Shape industrial capacity and market structure
notes: The table summarizes the strategy rather than listing every plan instrument.
It is useful for showing the policy's growth side alongside its redistribution side.
Keep the focus on the 1970s and 1980s through 1990.

tables.title: NEP Outcomes and Debates
matrix: Established poverty reduction as a state objective
Broader bumiputera entry into education and employment
Distribution of high-value ownership remained debated
Changed the composition of the middle class
Risk of uneven benefits and political capture
Critiques of patronage and ethnic classification persisted
Carried forward into the 1991 policy transition
notes: This table is deliberately balanced between gains and criticism.
It should support benchmark extraction of both success and tradeoff.
The legacy row bridges cleanly to the next policy frame.
